static_traits.name: Li Mei
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues are affected (due to frequently seeking reassurance and recognition); has several friends to talk to but often hesitates to share their own worries
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no similar psychological problems have emerged before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe trigger situations and consequences concretely; overall negative tone, tending toward catastrophizing and predicting the future; skeptical but willing to try in counseling; inclined to seek reassurance from others

basic_info.main_problem: I constantly worry about being fired by the hotel, and believe that once fired I will never find new Work again. These thoughts have recurred over the past months, affecting my Work performance and physical/mental state.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the persistent fear of losing my job significantly affects my mental health and job performance.
growth_experiences: A mistake at Work several months ago triggered intense stress. Since then, when facing challenging tasks or stressful situations at Work, she repeatedly has the thought that 'any mistake means being fired', gradually developing Persistent anxiety and Anticipation of the worst outcome; this affects Work focus and output, and extends into life (difficulty sleeping and eating), while Damaged relationships with colleagues from frequently seeking their reassurance and approval.

core_beliefs: At this age no one is willing to hire me
If I am fired, I will never find Work again

special_situations.event: When facing high-pressure or challenging work tasks at the hotel
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake under pressure, I will be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently seeking reassurance and approval from colleagues to ease uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I'll mess things up and get fired

special_situations.event: Periods when small errors occur at work or after difficult tasks end
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake equals losing the job
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly cautious, highly vigilant as if treading on thin ice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If there's any mistake, I'm done for

special_situations.event: Repeatedly recalling daytime work events at home, difficulty falling asleep at night
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Problems at work inevitably head toward the worst outcome
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitates to share worries with friends; bears them alone and thinks repeatedly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be without Work, unable to pay bills, and end up homeless

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues and needing to ask for advice or collaborate
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get reassurance from colleagues, I am more likely to make mistakes and be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seeking reassurance and validation from others to lower Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may already be tired of me

core_conflict.wish: Desires stable, secure work and recognition from colleagues
core_conflict.fear: Fear of Being rejected and fired after mistakes, ultimately losing livelihood and security
defense_goal: Lowering uncertainty and Anxiety by staying highly vigilant and frequently seeking reassurance from others

object_relations.self_representation: Anxiety, an easily judged survivor (worrying about being fired and not being hired)
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may be dissatisfied, judgmental, and rejecting (e.g., colleagues, employers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to seek less reassurance, try behavioral experiments, or face uncertainty
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe I am unable to cope and will fail, further worrying this will lead to being fired (seeing others as authorities who may reject or punish at any time)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond in a gentle, supportive tone, acknowledging their doubts and unease; use concretization and Guidance-style Questioning, inviting descriptions of feelings and evidence, gently examining catastrophic inferences, avoiding confrontational language.

manifestations: Having friends but often hesitating to share my Fear and Anxiety
At home, repeatedly ponders work problems; hard to fall asleep at night

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Highly sensitive to mistakes; cautious as if walking on thin ice
Frequently seeks reassurance and approval from others
Excessively worries about the worst outcome in the face of pressure tasks

positive_force: In the past, still able to keep the job despite mistakes, indicating a certain capacity for coping and recovery
Self-awareness: can identify the impact of catastrophic thinking on emotions, and is willing to try new methods
Has some social support (colleagues and a few friends)
negative_force: Thinking patterns of catastrophizing, predicting the future, and overgeneralization
Dependence on external validation (frequently seeking reassurance)
Age-related Self-doubt (believing it is hard to be hired at 51)
Sleep and eating affected, leading to decreased energy and concentration

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety in Work situations with frequent seeking of reassurance/validation from others
antecedent: Facing challenging tasks or high-pressure work situations
After a small mistake at work or just completing a difficult task
Repeatedly recalling daytime work events at home, difficulty falling asleep at night
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic and future-predicting cognitions formed after one Work mistake (mistake = being fired; being fired = never able to work again and becoming homeless), with age-related Self-doubt (believing it is hard to be hired at 51)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and Anxiety, gaining brief security through external soothing/reassurance
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, impaired focus and output; Tense relationships with colleagues; Sleep and diet affected, overall physical and mental health deteriorating
